dense_input: Reuse Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B page vectors from the previous pinned run
new_query_instruction: Given a financial question, retrieve document pages that contain relevant evidence.
notes: Validation selects parameters. Evaluation labels are used only after selection is frozen.
All 1854 variants are processed; test partition and development partitions are reported explicitly.
Translations and English questions sharing identical relevance signatures stay together.
Query counts use prefixes of the same five generated alternatives.
Fusion weight is selected using original-query dense results and frozen across expansion strategies.
Original queries and single-query baselines use the same selected BM25 settings.
These queries were examined in prior experiments; test refers to optimizer-held-out evaluation.
Only query text is sent to the generator. No corpus passages, gold answers or qrels enter query-generation calls.
